price_feed.note: When a CJ product feed is connected, set feed.price, feed.currency, and feed.sku on a product. feed.url may replace the plain product URL only when it is an https link on the merchant's own host. A tracking URL in feed.url is ignored and is never requested. merchants[].cj_click_url is the only place a CJ click URL is stored, and the build appends sid there without requesting it.

delta-carry-on-policy.label: Delta carry-on baggage
delta-carry-on-policy.quote: Combined length + width + height of baggage must not exceed 45 linear inches (114 cm). Individual length, width and height measurements may not exceed 22” x 14” x 9” (56 cm x 35 cm x 23 cm) respectively. These measurements include any handles or wheels.
